description.value: My Toan is a Vietnamese restaurant chain founded by an immigrant entrepreneur who brought traditional Vietnamese cooking from his hometown to Vancouver over 30 years ago. The Harbour Centre location sits in the mall food court at basement level (unit FC-14), offering a broad menu spanning pho, rice and noodle combinations, fresh salad rolls, baguettes, and Vietnamese crepes. The chain operates multiple Metro Vancouver locations and partners with food delivery platforms for online ordering.
